description: Java entity class representing an OrderAccount in an e-commerce system, including fields for order details, start/end dates, billing day, and associated products.

classes.name: OrderAccount
classes.description: Entity class for order account details, including relationships to Order and OrderAccountProduct.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the order account.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the order account.

methods.name: getOrderAccountStartDate
methods.description: Returns a clone of the start date of the order account.

methods.name: setOrderAccountStartDate
methods.description: Sets the start date of the order account, cloning the input date.

methods.name: getOrderAccountEndDate
methods.description: Returns a clone of the end date of the order account.

methods.name: setOrderAccountEndDate
methods.description: Sets the end date of the order account, cloning the input date.

methods.name: getOrderAccountBillDay
methods.description: Returns the billing day of the order account.

methods.name: setOrderAccountBillDay
methods.description: Sets the billing day of the order account.

methods.name: getOrderAccountProducts
methods.description: Returns the set of associated OrderAccountProduct objects.
